scientific_integrity: The proof is an exact generator recurrence and boundary-value solution. Finite-state numerical comparisons are reproducibility checks, not substitutes for the general proof.
scientific_limitations: Finite stationary two-point functions and their joint weak-refresh scaling only; no full stationary law, mixing-time theorem, entropy production or historical priority certification.
title: Winding-class covariance crossover in noisy cyclic successor-copying rings
